question: Which state government honoured Vani Jairam with the MS Subbulakshmi Award for 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu government honored Vani Jairam with the MS Subbulakshmi Award in 2019.
 
• Vani Jairam is a renowned playback singer in India, celebrated for her work in multiple Indian languages.
 
• The MS Subbulakshmi Award is named after the legendary Carnatic vocalist MS Subbulakshmi.
 
• This award recognizes contributions to the field of music, celebrating the legacy and promoting the values upheld by MS Subbulakshmi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vani Jairam**

 
 
• Vani Jairam is a celebrated Indian playback singer known for her work in various Indian languages including Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.
 
• She has received several awards and accolades for her contributions to Indian music, including the National Film Award for Best Female Playback Singer.
 
• Her versatile singing style and ability to adapt to various genres have made her a prominent figure in Indian music.
 
 
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi**
 
 
• Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi, popularly known as MS Subbulakshmi, was an Indian Carnatic singer from Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was the first musician to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was known for her divine voice and her deep dedication to Carnatic music.
 
• Her performances have left a lasting legacy in the world of Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi Award**
 
 
• The MS Subbulakshmi Award is a prestigious recognition given to musicians who have made significant contributions to the field of music.
 
• This award honors the legacy of MS Subbulakshmi and aims to promote the values of excellence and dedication in music.
 
• Recipients of this award are chosen based on their contributions to preserving and promoting Indian classical music.
